# rind on `amd-ryzen-9-3900x`: AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor

3 runs of rind's own `admin/bench-report run` at [`0a768eb7`](https://github.com/moq-dev/rind/commit/0a768eb702b8bc7cf84ce2286b64e64489979d56), each pinned to one core. Every time is the median of the runs' criterion estimates (`amd-ryzen-9-3900x.json`, schema 1, with each run's estimate in `runs_ns`); [RUNS.md](RUNS.md) lists every run, [facts.txt](facts.txt) the hardware and load, and [NOTES.md](NOTES.md) how the host was run and what to read into the numbers.

- CPU: AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor (x86_64, 24 logical CPUs)
- OS: Oracle Linux Server 10.3 (Linux 6.12.0-208.112.5.3.el10uek.x86_64)
- Toolchain: rustc 1.98.1 (48a229cea 2026-09-01)
- OpenSSL linked: OpenSSL 3.5.9 29 Sep 2026 (Library: OpenSSL 3.5.9 29 Sep 2026)
- CPU features rind reads (rind-cpuid): adx, aes, pclmulqdq, bmi1, bmi2, movbe, popcnt, ssse3, sse4.1, avx, avx2, sha; absent: intel, vaes, vpclmulqdq, avx512f, avx512dq, avx512ifma, avx512bw, avx512vl, avx512vbmi, avx512vbmi2, sha512
- Libraries refused for missing CPU features: none
- Noisy (bench-report's flag, any run): no

## Gaps

Each operation where another library is more than 10% faster than rind, by rind's rule (OpenSSL counts), with its reason from [gaps.toml](gaps.toml). `cargo xtask host-report` refuses a gap without an entry and an entry that covers no gap.

| Operations | rind over the fastest | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `mlkem768-keygen` | 1.56× verified-garbage | 1.56x pyca/verified-garbage on the medians of three runs, larger than the 1.25x on Zen 3 (amd-ryzen-9-5900xt). Upstream decided this in kixel-ai/rind#812: on x86_64 without AVX-512 ML-KEM-768 key generation stays on rind's arithmetic because decapsulation, the hot path, runs on the arithmetic that generated the key and VG's decapsulation was 1.17-1.25x slower. Zen 2 was not among the hosts that decision measured, so the larger margin here should be rechecked against decapsulation on this CPU. |
